name: Spiraphim: New Game X
source:
After going through twelve playthroughs in your new favorite game and becoming obsessed with its lore, you wake up in its world. Torn between wanting to explore the world and wanting to find your way back home, on top of complete disbelief at your situation, you find yourself even more confused as several men seem to be inexpicably drawn to you.

Spiraphim is an Isekai Fantasy BL Visual Novel / Dating Sim set in the fictional world of Orbis Terrarum. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221101161049/https://spiraphim.itch.io/x]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在你最喜欢的新游戏中经历了十二次游戏并沉迷于它的故事之后，你在它的世界中醒来。在想要探索世界和想要找到回家的路之间左右为难，除了完全不相信自己的处境之外，你发现自己更加困惑，因为几个男人似乎莫名其妙地被你吸引。

Spiraphim是一款以Orbis Terrarum的虚构世界为背景的异世界奇幻BL视觉小说/约会模拟游戏。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221101161049/https://spiraphim.itch.io/x]Itch.io[/url]]
